About Indra Group and the Role

Indra Group is a leading company in the defense and technology sector, focused on developing technology solutions for national and international security. The company relies on robust and highly available IT systems and infrastructure to support its global operations. We are seeking a Systems Engineer Infrastructure & Applications Support to join our team in Saudi Arabia, specifically in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience in IT systems administration and maintenance.
Role Overview

The Systems Engineer will be responsible for the administration and maintenance of installed IT systems and infrastructure. This includes managing and monitoring systems to ensure high availability and executing both preventive and corrective maintenance activities. The role is critical for maintaining the operational integrity of our IT environment.
Key Responsibilities
• Manage and monitor all installed systems and infrastructure to ensure high availability.
• Install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems, application software, and system management tools.
• Monitor and test application performance, identify potential bottlenecks, and collaborate with developers on solutions.
• Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution.
• Execute maintenance duties according to the maintenance plan, including preventive procedures and schedules.
• Inspect and verify the status of assets and spare parts, performing corrective maintenance, repairs, and adjustments as needed.
• Submit maintenance checklist reports in accordance with work orders and maintenance plans.
• Troubleshoot issues by consulting as-built documents, schematics, and other relevant sources.
• Coordinate with Systems ML1 engineers to resolve incidents and analyze root causes.
Qualifications and Experience
• A minimum of 5-10 years of solid experience in IT systems administration and maintenance.
• Demonstrated ability to manage and monitor complex IT systems and infrastructure.
• Proficiency in installing, configuring, and maintaining operating systems and application software.
• Experience with performance monitoring and troubleshooting.
Work Environment and Company Culture

Indra Group offers a stable work environment with long-term projects within a leading defense company comprising over 65,000 professionals. The role involves working in an international setting on projects with national and global impact. The company fosters a close-knit, transparent environment with direct communication and a collaborative culture. Professionals are given autonomy and responsibility, with tailored career plans designed for professional growth and development. Indra Group is committed to promoting respectful and dignified work environments, ensuring equal opportunities, and providing a workplace free from discrimination.
About Indra Group

Indra Group is a Top Employer 2026 certified company, recognized for its comprehensive HR management and the conditions offered to its professionals. The company is dedicated to strengthening national and international security through cutting-edge technology solutions.

jobs.job_title: Operational Support Engineer – L2/L3 | UITCO | Riyadh

Driving platform stability, incident resolution, and continuous service availability in Riyadh, UITCO is actively seeking experienced Operational Support Engineers (L2/L3) for a permanent professional engagement. In this vital technical support role, you will ensure optimal system performance, resolve complex production incidents, and maintain high-availability IT infrastructures. Bringing strong L2/L3 production support experience and deep proficiency in root-cause analysis, you will empower corporate operations to achieve uncompromised uptime and operational excellence. This prestigious career opportunity offers competitive remuneration, high technical visibility, and exceptional professional growth within a premier technology solutions enterprise.
Detailed Job Description

As an Operational Support Engineer – L2/L3 supporting UITCO in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, you will take full operational, tactical, and technical ownership of platform troubleshooting, incident management, and performance monitoring. Your day-to-day responsibilities include investigating complex application and platform failures, conducting rigorous root-cause analyses, monitoring service availability metrics, and implementing ITIL-aligned support workflows. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional software engineering, infrastructure, and DevOps squads in fast-paced operational environments while ensuring rapid incident resolution. Furthermore, you will manage application requirements by submitting your updated CV via direct email to recruitment@uitco.com.sa.
Key Responsibilities
• Provide expert L2/L3 production support and technical troubleshooting for complex enterprise applications and platforms.
• Manage incident lifecycles, problem tickets, and root-cause analyses (RCA) to resolve critical operational bottlenecks.
• Monitor system performance, resource utilization, and service availability metrics across production environments.
• Implement proactive monitoring strategies, alerting thresholds, and automated health-check mechanisms.
• Coordinate seamlessly with cross-functional software engineering, QA, and infrastructure operations squads.
• Ensure strict adherence to ITIL service management frameworks, SLA response times, and resolution targets.
• Document incident resolutions, troubleshooting runbooks, and operational knowledge base articles.
• Participate in on-call rotation schedules and emergency response efforts for high-priority production incidents.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Minimum of 3+ years of progressive professional experience in L2/L3 production support and IT operations.
• Strong, demonstrable hands‑on professional expertise in application troubleshooting, log analysis, and platform diagnostics.
• Comprehensive working knowledge and practical proficiency in incident management, problem management, and root-cause analysis (RCA).
• Deep practical experience with enterprise monitoring, performance tuning, and service availability tracking.
• Solid practical grasp of ITIL service management frameworks and structured IT operational processes.
• Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication capabilities.
